text:
Megan L.: starting a quick config-only patch to routing and batching to smooth a midday spike. targeting 5% canary for 60m. keys: routing.policy=even_spread, batch.window_ms=15 -> 10, per_tenant_rate_limit=0.9x, timeout_ms=30000 -> 32000. no model changes. DeployBot: @Megan L. config-only deploy queued: change-id=cfg-2026-03-21-7, canary=5%, window=60m, initiated by Megan L.. monitor: /dash/cfg-2026-03-21-7 OpsBot: canary started at 1738888123, streaming logs -> https://ops.redwood/dash/cfg-2026-03-21-7
Srinivas: seeing a slight tail-latency bump on canary pods ~+12% at p95 after 8m. not huge but correlated with smaller batch.window_ms. snippet from logs: ```kvcache: evict_rate=0.03, batch_sz_p50=2, p95_latency_ms=210 -> 235``` Ben: hmm. if smaller batch window reduces batching, cost might go up too. can we pin a handful of high-volume tenants to prev config while we observe? Megan L.: yes let's pin the top 3 tenants for now (tenant-a, tenant-b, tenant-c) to cfg-prev; apply pin immediately and leave canary at 5% elsewhere. DeployBot: pin applied: tenant-a->cfg-prev, tenant-b->cfg-prev, tenant-c->cfg-prev. change-id=cfg-2026-03-21-pins
Emily: agree with pins. also set an automated rollback trigger: if error-rate > 0.7% OR p95 increase > 25% sustained for 10m, rollback. can we add that to the canary? DeployBot: rollback policy attached to canary cfg-2026-03-21-7: errors>0.7% OR p95_delta>25% for 10m -> AUTO-ROLLBACK
Charlie: +1. also flag alert to paging at 3x baseline errors. OpsBot: alert rule created and muted for unrelated flapping. link -> https://ops.redwood/alerts/5232
Srinivas: after pins, tail latency looks better in pinned tenants. the canary cohort still shows small variance but within 15%. I'm comfortable holding for another 30m. Megan L.: plan: reduce canary to 2% to limit blast radius and extend observation to 90m. if stable, roll to 25% tomorrow morning during a quiet window. Ben: sounds good. please also annotate release notes: include rationale (mitigate surge smoothing), exact keys changed, and the pin list. Megan L.: notes added to change doc: "routing even_spread; batch.window_ms 15->10; per_tenant_rate_limit 0.9x; timeout_ms 30000->32000; pinned tenant-a,b,c; canary 2%/90m; rollback rules attached." DeployBot: canary adjusted: canary=2%, window=90m for cfg-2026-03-21-7. action log: adjust by Megan L.
Emily: runbook reminder for rollback (copy): ```1) curl -X POST https://deploy.redwood/api/rollback -d '{"change_id":"cfg-2026-03-21-7"}' 2) verify pins exist: GET /config/pins -> ensure tenant-a,b,c are set 3) notify #eng-sre and #product 4) monitor for errors 5) open incident if >1% errors for 15m``` Megan L.: executing monitoring play. please don't merge any unrelated config changes into routing until we finish. Charlie: I'll hold off on related QOS patches. Srinivas: I'll keep an eye on KV cache pressure and batching histograms; will post updates every 10m. OpsBot: canary at 2% stable after 12m, p95 delta ~+10%, errors 0.05%. next update at 22m. Megan L.: thanks all — if anyone sees anything concerning, call rollback. otherwise we'll reconvene at end of observation window and decide next steps. :white_check_mark:
